prompt: Why is subword tokenization such as byte pair encoding (BPE) useful for handling rare or unseen words?

options.text: It stores every possible word in a very large dictionary.
It encodes rare and unknown words as sequences of smaller, known subword units instead of failing on them.
It replaces unknown words with a single placeholder token.
It translates rare words into the most similar common word first.

explanation: Sennrich et al. introduced BPE-based subword units so models can handle an open vocabulary: rare and unknown words become sequences of subword units. A byte-level BPE can encode arbitrary text, including text it never saw in training.

sources.title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units (Sennrich et al.)
